selection.name: C01 — mcporter
selection.role: Provisional bridge and configuration CLI for agent sessions; evaluated release 0.14.2 and default-branch commit 9d3cf4f.

basis.shows: Imports Claude Code and Codex configurations; connects through stdio, Streamable HTTP and legacy SSE; provides tool/resource calls, generated CLIs and record/replay. Documents npm installation with Node 24+, Vitest tests and Linux/macOS/Windows CI.
Successful CI on the inspected default-branch commit, completed October 1, 2026. This establishes upstream CI success, not measured superiority on WSL2.
Released October 1, 2026; documents OAuth refresh protection, installed-package verification and daemon fixes.
Not archived; zero open issues/PRs at inspection. Default-branch API returned an October 1 commit. MIT license.

selection.name: C02 — MCP Inspector
selection.role: Provisional inspection companion with web, scriptable CLI and terminal interfaces; evaluated release 2.9.0 and default-branch commit ae865a19.

basis.shows: Documents web, CLI and TUI launch commands, Node >=22.19, server configuration guides and composable test servers. Its validation suite includes unit tests; the documented coverage gate is >=90% per file, which is a policy rather than a retrieved coverage measurement.
Successful CI on the inspected default-branch commit, completed September 30, 2026.
Released September 30, 2026, with community-reported fixes. Documents a shared-server OAuth-profile token-overwrite issue and a per-profile secret-store workaround.
Not archived; 62 open issues/PRs at inspection. Default-branch API returned a September 30 commit.

not_selected.name: inspector
not_selected.reason: A current, locally installable alternative with OAuth debugging and cross-client evaluations, but no reviewed head-to-head establishes an incremental advantage for this requirement over the provisional pair. [README](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/blob/6091586c4920898595e47d1672b3206c365e1751/README.md), [October 1 release](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/releases/tag/v3.12.8).

not_selected.name: microsoft/mcp-gateway, docker/mcp-registry, modelcontextprotocol/registry
not_selected.reason: All three are current; the gateway has published test results, but Kubernetes routing and registry operation address no concrete workstation surface gap established here, so defer this bundle. [Gateway validation](https://github.com/microsoft/mcp-gateway/commit/ce37788ae0719fd73a1707c9a7bc379a68dd775e), [Docker registry](https://api.github.com/repos/docker/mcp-registry), [MCP registry](https://api.github.com/repos/modelcontextprotocol/registry).

excluded.name: @wong2/mcp-cli 2.0.0
excluded.fact: Not archived, but its latest default-branch commit is June 8, 2026, outside the frozen 90-day window. The latest-release endpoint returned HTTP 404. [Commit](https://github.com/wong2/mcp-cli/commit/7d12b4648b1c3e2a7341113407002c1b0f700d1b).

excluded.name: Awesome MCP servers registry
excluded.fact: Upstream describes this repository as a collection of MCP servers: a discovery source rather than an executable bridge, inspector or configurator. No specific listed server has a demonstrated surface gap and completed examination here. [Repository metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers).

layers.deciding_comparison: The complementary pair is provisional, without a measured winner. On clean WSL2 Ubuntu, compare mcporter 0.14.2, MCP Inspector 2.9.0 and MCPJam 3.12.8 using the same explicitly reviewed servers: Claude Code/Codex config handling, modern and legacy transports, OAuth isolation, tools/resources/prompts, lifecycle recovery, reproducible output, setup effort and resource use. Compare each inspector paired with mcporter as well as standalone operation. Review registry entries only when this exposes a concrete missing capability.
evidence_gaps: The packet reports a 37/37 lifecycle tie between older mcporter and Inspector releases, plus a mcporter ps regression; it supplies no public harness URL, so this was not counted as independently verified public benchmark evidence.

Linux suitability is supported by the documented Node install paths and mcporter's stated CI platforms. WSL2-specific behavior and macOS arm64 validation were not established by the sources read. This layer has no GPU requirement.

CI conclusions were retrieved, but detailed logs, actual coverage figures and tagged-package target-host results were not. MCPJam's sampled runs were older preview/canary workflows and cannot establish its inspection-suite quality.
Issue counts include pull requests and do not measure responsiveness. Recent selected-project releases document fixes, but issue-response rates were not measured.
Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls and one web search. The bundled gateway/registry installation documentation was not verified.

Automatic approval review rejected ctx_fetch_and_index because approval is required and the session policy is never. A delegate then directly opened four READMEs in error; those reads were set aside. The leading tools' READMEs were reverified through GitHub API endpoints, so the requested ctx_fetch_and_index/ctx_search workflow could not be completed.
